meta.title: 微信会话互通 (WeChat Session Bridge)
meta.description: WeChat channel adapter (v2.1.0): does not depend on dsh-im and does not take over session lifecycle. After QR login it sends/receives over the built-in iLink protocol; in WeChat use /use to bind an existing session, or /new to create one in the configured workspace group and auto-bind it, with bindings persisted across restarts. Two-way chat: plain text is prompted into the session and the agent final reply is mirrored back headed by the session title. Parallel multi-session approval and choice fill-in: rich cards carry a short session prefix; reply prefix=1 approve / prefix=0 reject / prefix=c cancel, or prefix 1A 2B, to settle exactly that session (including unbound ones, racing the native DSH UI with first answer winning), never misrouted or guessed as the latest. Includes timeout reminder cards, permissionPreset auto-fallback, and a periodic pending summary; archived/deleted sessions get a clear notice and no false alerts. Zero runtime dependencies.
